review.notes: Triage review: all 49 physical pages machine-scanned (no code fences; normalized 4-gram page-text containment, mean 0.97; per-word presence check; pattern scan). Flagged pages inspected line-by-line: pages 5-8 flagged tokens are figure-diagram labels (embedded figures); pages 39-43 flags are prompt text inside figure images; pages 4, 13, 14, 19, 22, 27 revealed seven dropped footnote bodies whose superscript markers survive (footnotes 5, 6, table footnotes 5-6, 9, 10, 11, 12); pages 44-45 revealed Table 7 and Table 8 merged into one OCR table with a glued header row, plus six OCR auto-corrections of the print's own misspellings in table cells (cigarrette, transportion, Descritpions, recyling, Decriptions, occurences). Pages 14 and 44 rendered and visually verified; remaining patch pages verified against the extracted PDF text layer.
